concepts.name: Nigredo
concepts.description: The blackening stage in alchemical transformation, representing putrefaction, dissolution, and the death of the old self. Central to Rosicrucian and theosophical alchemy as the necessary precursor to spiritual rebirth.

concepts.name: Albedo
concepts.description: The whitening or purification stage in alchemy, following nigredo. Symbolizes clarification, washing away impurities, and the ascent toward perfection.

concepts.name: Rubedo
concepts.description: The reddening or final stage of alchemical transformation, representing perfection, completion, and the creation of the Philosopher's Stone or elixir. The goal of the Great Work.

concepts.name: Theosis
concepts.description: Divine union or deification; the process of human transformation toward unity with the Divine. Rosicrucian alchemy reinterprets this Neoplatonic concept as the alchemical union of matter and spirit.

concepts.name: Hieros Gamos
concepts.description: Sacred marriage or the conjunction of opposites; the union of masculine and feminine principles, sun and moon, sulfur and mercury. Central to alchemical symbolism and Rosicrucian cosmology.

concepts.name: Lapis Philosophorum
concepts.description: The Philosopher's Stone; the ultimate goal of the Great Work in alchemy. Symbolizes spiritual perfection, universal knowledge, and the transmutation of base metals into gold (understood as metaphorical and spiritual, as well as material).

concepts.name: Rosy Cross
concepts.description: The central symbol of Rosicrucianism, combining the rose (feminine, regeneration, love) with the cross (masculine, sacrifice, redemption). Represents the union of opposites and spiritual initiation.

concepts.name: Correspondentia
concepts.description: The doctrine of correspondences (as above, so below); the belief that all levels of reality (divine, celestial, terrestrial) are interconnected and reflected in one another. Foundation of Hermetic and alchemical thinking.

concepts.name: Putrefactio
concepts.description: Putrefaction; the decomposition and fermentation phase in alchemy, essential to transformation. Marks the transition from nigredo to other stages, symbolizing the necessary destruction before renewal.

concepts.name: Quaternio
concepts.description: The sacred four; a fundamental pattern in alchemical and Rosicrucian cosmology representing completeness and balance. Appears in four elements, four directions, four stages of the Work.

emblem_books.title: Atalanta Fugiens
emblem_books.subject: Alchemical Emblem Book
emblem_books.description: Michael Maier's masterwork of alchemical emblems with attached epigrams and musical notation. Central to emblem scholarship and alchemical iconography.

emblem_books.title: Mutus Liber
emblem_books.subject: Alchemical Emblem Book
emblem_books.description: A wordless book of alchemical emblems and engravings, representing the silent or secret nature of the Great Work.
